groups.defect: Nonpositive process limits are mishandled: negative values can leave flushing disabled, and explicit zero selects maximum fan-out instead of being distinguished from None.
groups.rationale: Both report the same negative-limit validation defect in the constructor. s_ed5056d1 additionally reports the zero-versus-None conflation, which must survive consolidation.

groups.defect: Flusher metrics inconsistently use shard versus shards tag keys, and use individual shard IDs versus comma-joined shard groups as values.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same incorrect tag key on wait_produce. s_d8e8bf32 additionally flags inconsistent tag value formats between the main-loop and unhealthy metrics.

groups.defect: The added test sleep is neutralized by the existing monkeypatch, so it provides no synchronization before shutdown.
groups.rationale: Both report the identical no-op sleep and resulting lack of synchronization at the same test lines.
